title.en: Reading A Tale of Two Cities: restored English and five complete new editions
title.zh: 《双城记》：补全英文，新增五语全文
title.zh-hant: 《雙城記》：補全英文，新增五語全文

summary.en: Four essays restore the narrative scenes and argument in English and add complete Japanese, French, German, Spanish and Korean editions. Source-verified factual corrections are synchronized in Simplified and Traditional Chinese.
summary.zh: 4 篇散文补全英文场景与论证，新增日、法、德、西、韩全文；按原著核实的事实纠错同步到简繁中文。
summary.zh-hant: 4 篇散文補全英文場景與論證，新增日、法、德、西、韓全文；按原著核實的事實糾錯同步到簡繁中文。
